# Tasksetly

> AI API Gateway Platform for Subscription Quota Distribution

## Overview

Tasksetly is an AI API gateway that enables subscription-based quota distribution across multiple AI providers including Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and others.

## Core Features

- Unified API access to multiple AI providers
- Subscription and recharge-based quota management
- Multi-tenant support with role-based access control
- Real-time usage tracking and analytics
- OAuth integration (GitHub, Google, WeChat, DingTalk, OIDC)
- Multi-language support (English, Chinese)

## Technology Stack

- Backend: Go 1.27+, PostgreSQL 15+, Redis 7+
- Frontend: Vue 3.4+, TypeScript, TailwindCSS
- Deployment: Docker, Kubernetes-ready

## Documentation

- GitHub: https://github.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api
- Setup Guide: /docs/quickstart.html
- API Documentation: Available after deployment
